image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of two containers of ice cream. The foreground container holds a scoop of light beige or off-white ice cream with a textured surface. Behind it is another container with brownish/tan ice cream. To the right, there is a blue and white package with illegible text that resembles Asian characters or gibberish. In the background, there are blurry shapes including what looks like sliced fruit (possibly mango or peach) and a blue cup. A yellow graphic overlay is visible at the bottom.
